channel.title: Neural Critic
channel.description: Gaming news, reviews, guides, and features for players who want the signal—not the noise.

item.title: Elden Ring Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 Location
item.description: Find Somberstone Miner's Bell Bearing 5 in Elden Ring, follow the route from Beside the Great Bridge, and unlock unlimited Somber Smithing Stone 9 purchases.

item.title: Elden Ring Somber Smithing Stone 9 Locations: Where to Find and Buy Them
item.description: Find Somber Smithing Stone 9 locations in Elden Ring, where to buy them infinitely, how to get one early, and which Bell Bearing unlocks the shop.

item.title: Elden Ring Smithing Stone 8 Locations: Where to Find and Buy Them
item.description: Find Smithing Stone 8 locations in Elden Ring, where to buy them infinitely, which Bell Bearing unlocks them, and how many you need for +24.

item.title: The Xbox Reset Explained: What Happens to Halo, Forza, Fallout, Rare and Ninja Theory Now?
item.description: Microsoft’s latest Xbox restructuring moves major studios under Activision and Bethesda, combines Playground with Turn 10, cuts 268 roles, and puts Ninja Theory at risk of closure. Here is what actually changed and what each move means.

item.title: Halo Is Moving to Activision. Here’s What That Actually Means for Its Future
item.description: Activision developing the next mainline Halo does not automatically mean Halo becomes Call of Duty. The bigger change is production: Xbox is putting the franchise inside a publishing machine built to ship large games on a dependable cadence.

item.title: There’s Something About gen ATLAS I Haven’t Felt From a Game in Years
item.description: I’m excited for gen ATLAS for an unusual reason: almost everything that makes me want to play it comes from what Fumito Ueda still refuses to explain.

item.title: gen ATLAS Looks Like Fumito Ueda’s Most Ambitious World Yet
item.description: Fumito Ueda’s first open-world game is not interesting because it is bigger. gen ATLAS looks compelling because it turns his oldest ideas — scale, companionship, silence and interpretation — into systems that can shape an entire world.

item.title: PHYSINT Casts Bill Skarsgård as Its Lead as Kojima Productions Expands Xbox Partnership
item.description: Hideo Kojima confirmed Bill Skarsgård as PHYSINT’s lead during Xbox’s Tokyo Game Show 2026 broadcast, alongside new artwork and fresh details on the project’s Xbox publishing partnership.

item.title: Xbox Tokyo Game Show 2026: The Biggest Announcements From PHYSINT to Faraday Blues
item.description: Xbox’s Tokyo Game Show 2026 broadcast delivered 17 reveals and updates, including PHYSINT casting news, new Wo Long 2 gameplay, Faraday Blues’ world premiere, Persona 4 Revival and more.

item.title: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember Launches March 4, 2027, With an Alpha Demo Available Now
item.description: Team NINJA has dated Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember for March 4, 2027, while a limited-time alpha demo lets players sample the sequel ahead of launch.

item.title: Faraday Blues Revealed at TGS 2026 With Three Interconnected Stories and 64 Endings
item.description: Serenity Forge unveiled Faraday Blues at Xbox’s Tokyo Game Show 2026 broadcast, a surreal sci-fi adventure about rewriting a family’s fate across three linked visual novels.

item.title: PlayStation’s Fairgames Appears to Have Resurfaced as ‘Project Espresso’ in a New PS5 and PC Playtest
item.description: A closed PS5 and PC playtest for an unannounced PvPvE heist shooter codenamed Project Espresso closely matches Haven Studios’ Fairgames, while Insider Gaming reports the projects are the same.

item.title: GTA VI’s Six-Hour Netflix Preview Reportedly Drove More Than 100,000 U.S. Sign-Ups
item.description: GTA VI’s six-hour Netflix-exclusive Extended Look reportedly drove more than 100,000 U.S. sign-ups, making it one of Netflix’s biggest subscriber events of 2026.

item.title: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United Is a Full 3D Remake Launching February 16, 2027
item.description: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United launches February 16, 2027 as a full 3D remake with eight protagonists, a new timeline battle system and United Attacks.

item.title: Persona 4 Revival Comes to Switch 2 on May 20, 2027 — Three Months After Other Platforms
item.description: Persona 4 Revival launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on May 20, 2027, while the PS5, Xbox Series X|S and PC versions arrive February 18.

item.title: Yo-kai Watch 2: Haunted Domain Revives the 3DS Adventure on Switch 2 With Enhanced Graphics and New Content
item.description: Level-5 is bringing Yo-kai Watch 2 back on Nintendo Switch 2 with enhanced graphics, new story content and additional Yo-kai, though no release date has been announced.

item.title: Monster Hunter Wilds Comes to Switch 2 on December 4 — All Title Updates Included, Ascendance Follows in 2027
item.description: Monster Hunter Wilds launches on Nintendo Switch 2 on December 4, 2026 with all Title Update content included, full cross-platform multiplayer support and the Ascendance expansion coming in 2027.

item.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis Switch 2 Preorders Are Live — Deluxe Edition Includes 48-Hour Early Access
item.description: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is now available to preorder on Nintendo Switch 2 ahead of its February 12, 2027 launch, with a Deluxe Edition offering 48-hour early access and additional content.

item.title: Kirby and the World Beyond Revealed for Switch 2 — New 3D Adventure Launches Spring 2027
item.description: Nintendo has revealed Kirby and the World Beyond, a new 3D Kirby adventure for Nintendo Switch 2 launching in spring 2027 with expansive exploration and powered-up Copy Abilities.

item.title: Persona 6 Is Coming to Nintendo Switch 2 — Atlus Confirms the Long-Awaited RPG for Nintendo’s New Console
item.description: Atlus has confirmed Persona 6 for Nintendo Switch 2, bringing the next mainline Persona RPG to Nintendo’s latest system. No release date has been announced yet.

item.title: Metroid Ravenous Revealed for Switch 2 — Samus Embraces Her Metroid Powers in a Darker Follow-Up to Dread
item.description: Nintendo has revealed Metroid Ravenous for Nintendo Switch 2, launching January 28, 2027. We break down Samus’ new energy-absorbing abilities, combat, enemies, story clues and everything shown in the first trailer.

item.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Remake Launches November 5 — New Gameplay Reveals Jumping, Free Camera and More
item.description: Nintendo has given The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time its biggest remake showcase yet, confirming a November 5, 2026 release date and detailing major gameplay and quality-of-life changes for Switch 2.

item.title: Nintendo Reveals New Zelda LEGO Set Featuring Link and Epona for the Series’ 40th Anniversary
item.description: Nintendo has revealed a new The Legend of Zelda LEGO set featuring Link and Epona, alongside a playable Ocarina, during Zelda’s 40th Anniversary Direct.

item.title: The Legend of Zelda Movie Reveals Its Official Logo — and Nintendo Confirms There’s No Subtitle
item.description: Nintendo has revealed the official logo for its live-action The Legend of Zelda movie and confirmed that the April 2027 film will simply be titled The Legend of Zelda.

item.title: The Witcher 3 Beginner’s Guide: Combat, Signs, Alchemy and Exploration
item.description: A practical Witcher 3 beginner’s guide for version 4.04, covering combat, Signs, alchemy, skills, quests and exploration before Remastered launches.

item.title: The Witcher 3 Best Skills and Abilities for New Players
item.description: The best Witcher 3 skills for new players in version 4.04, including early combat priorities, Quen, Axii and smart build choices before Remastered.

item.title: Every Game Awards Game of the Year Winner Since 2014
item.description: Every Game Awards Game of the Year winner from 2014 through 2025, from Dragon Age: Inquisition to Clair Obscur: Expedition 33, with year-by-year context.

item.title: The 12 Best Action RPGs
item.description: The 12 best action RPGs to play in 2026, ranked for combat, progression, build variety and exploration, from Elden Ring and Bloodborne to Cyberpunk 2077.

item.title: Why The Witcher 3’s Side Quests Still Set the Standard
item.description: Why The Witcher 3’s side quests still set the standard: local stakes, memorable characters, moral uncertainty, consequences and quest chains with real narrative weight.

item.title: Dark Souls Remastered Beginner’s Guide: What to Know Before Lordran
item.description: A practical Dark Souls Remastered beginner’s guide covering bonfires, Estus, leveling, equipment load, upgrades, exploration and the early lessons that make Lordran easier to understand.
